brand.source: Existing Neo4j Standard Template — Editable; inherited logos and motifs retained in the native deck.

conventions.graph_record: Native ELLIPSE with equal physical width and height; separate transparent text box for labels.
conventions.workflow: Rounded process cards; explicit directional arrows.
conventions.storage_boundary: Containers, property panels and authority/evidence labels.
conventions.relationships: Full stored names, direction, arrowheads and source endpoint are meaningful.
conventions.density: Keep code, schemas, field names, source paths, scope and outcome semantics visible; no guaranteed result claims.
conventions.typography: Preserve existing font roles. Graph node labels are 12pt; relationships/properties are template-style captions.
conventions.source_scope: This JSON describes diagram scenes and all-slide design decisions, not the complete native deck state. The Google Slides deck is the authoritative editable presentation.
conventions.reading_order: Graph descriptions identify each source, relationship and target. Large diagrams include a visible linear path and native alternative descriptions.

diagrams.title: Anatomy of a trace

elements.text: The tool call carries arguments, result and executed SQL. The trace stores reply and outcome.
Trace → step → tool call → tool. TOUCHED associates each captured step with its selected case.

diagrams.description: A reasoning trace has a reasoning step. The step uses a tool call, which is an instance of a tool. A message initiated the trace. TOUCHED connects a step to the selected case customer and plan. The arguments, result and recorded SQL describe the operation.

elements.text:
Distillation abstracts a repeatable procedure from selected observations and executions.

Workshop review submission is automated; a production human decision requires a separate policy/workflow.
